name: Nico
summary: A Mac voice-to-action agent that runs tasks on the AI account you already have; Plus adds spoken replies and better recognition.
description: Nico is a macOS voice-to-action personal agent. New accounts get 7 days of Plus with no card. Yearly billing is offered with a stated 20% saving. The site also lists many UI languages.

pricing.details: Free, no card (tasks use the AI plan you already have; text replies and on-device recognition); Plus 13 €/month (full voice conversations and higher accuracy). 7 days of Plus free, no card. Yearly billing 20% off (yearly totals not published).
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Uses the AI account you already have
On-device speech recognition on the Free plan
Spoken replies and higher accuracy on Plus
7 days of Plus free, no card
